name: leiden
reference: Traag, Waltman & van Eck. From Louvain to Leiden: guaranteeing well-connected communities. Sci. Rep. 2019. (python-igraph community_leiden, modularity objective)

resolution.doc: Modularity resolution gamma. 1.0 is standard modularity; tuned as the granularity knob, like Louvain.

n_iterations.doc: Leiden iterations. igraph's default is 2 (Protocol A); set -1 to run until the partition is stable (Protocol B). A compute knob, not a tuned hyperparameter.
